svg.title: Arithmetic-validated prefix transcripts certify projected coverage
svg.desc: Validate schema, exact restricted identities, roots and the supported domain before combining refuted prefixes with verified model-projection cylinders. Complete coverage certifies the returned projected set, not all auxiliary roots. All seven independent fixed software joints hold; no speedup or ECDLP claim.

g.text: Validate arithmetic first; then check projected coverage
7 independent joints hold · 148 named cases · 1,887 assertion evaluations · zero solver calls
Fixed fiber control: full roots {0,2,4,6} → returned projections {0,2}
A model proves its projection exists. It does not make every auxiliary assignment in that fiber a root.
No arbitrary-CNF support, primality certification, whole-pipeline nonenumeration or performance claim.
